performance.speaker: narrator
performance.direction: Authoritarian but natural, like an archivist reading an uncontested public record. Mid-low register, measured breath, no movie-trailer growl. Small pause after the first sentence, isolate Chog, then let erased land coldly. Do not sound triumphant or imitate a real public figure.

speak.prosody: Two centuries ago, the world survived the creatures that nearly destroyed it. Their name was Chog. Their memory was the last danger we erased.
